<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type FaqCardsProps = {
    items: Question[];
    labels: FaqSplitLabels;
    cards?: "grid3" | "grid4" | "icons";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">

  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";

  let { items, labels, cards = "grid3" }: FaqCardsProps = $props();
</script>

<Box
  class={
    (cards as string) === "grid4" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4"
    : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
  }
  data-slot="faq"
>
  {#each items as q (q.id)}
    <ArticleBlock class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6" testid="faq-card">
      {#if ((cards as string) === "icons")}
        <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
          <LucideIcon name={q.icon} size={20} />
        </Box>
      {/if}
      <Stack gap="2">
        <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm" class="w-fit">
          {q.category}
        </Badge>
        <Title as={3} size="base" weight="semibold">
          {q.question}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {q.answer}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Box class="mt-auto">
        <Button variant="link" size="sm" class="gap-2 px-0 font-medium">
          {labels.more}
          <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
        </Button>
      </Box>

</Box>
